correctness.rationale: The exit-side chain follows exactly from the rational gambler-ruin Dirichlet problem with m visited sites. When the drift log-odds is theta, the near-unbiased mismatch per stage is at most e*theta through m<=1/theta. In the remaining tail, unfavored-side arrivals have summable probability; binary alternation bounds both kinds of switches. This proves an absolute L1 error below 7 for all n,p, without extrapolating finite tests. At symmetry all switch indicators are independent Bernoulli(1/(m+1)). The triangular-array Lindeberg theorem and an L1-to-probability estimate give the CLT, with harmonic means and variances. At fixed nonzero drift summability proves almost-sure finite alternations under one infinite-chain coupling. Exact rational full-step simulations and independent Dirichlet elimination passed 2435 checks, with raw-step unresolved probability explicitly bounded by 1e-12.

originality.rationale: The 2026 cycle last-coverage paper provides the discovery-chain transition matrices, which are explicitly treated as prior inputs, but does not analyze the total number of changes between frontiers, state the exact unbiased switch-count generating function, or establish uniform-in-bias L1 coupling to an independent Bernoulli sum and the resulting all-triangular-array critical drift crossover. Standard record-count literature counts time-indexed upper records, not frontier switching indexed by successive discoveries. No equivalent statement was located in current public scientific searches or accessible claim summaries. This is a qualified priority assessment; the predecessor transitions mathematically enable the new proof but do not themselves constitute the uniform coupling theorem.
residual_risks: The transition matrices in Idnani–Salem determine the frontier-switch law implicitly; novelty attaches to the quantitative uniform coupling and derived singular drift-scale CLT, not to the matrix itself.
An earlier result about alternating upper and lower record frontiers may exist under different terminology; no claim of exhaustive historical coverage.
Recordary/semantic retrieval and search absence alone are not proofs of novelty.

value.rationale: The alternation count measures repeated changes in the leading exploration boundary, a natural trajectory statistic distinct from cover time and the last-covered site. The absolute drift-uniform L1 comparison gives a nonasymptotic transfer device, identifies effective frontier length min(n,1/|log odds|), and proves the Gaussian logarithmic crossover from symmetric walks to the fixed-bias finite-switch regime. Its power-law drift phase diagram holds for a full continuum of bias-decay rates. Exact Bernoulli symmetry is structurally unexpected but is not used alone to justify value.
